name: nobufil GmbH
summary: Austrian filament manufacturer in Krems an der Donau, founded in 2022 by Alexander Datzinger, extruding in-house from recycled EU industrial plastic waste. Its proprietary 'x' line (PLAx, ABSx, PCx) is positioned as enhanced-polymer grades rather than commodity material, and the range extends into fibre-filled PLA, PCTG and PC.

product_lines.name: PLAx
product_lines.notes: Impact-modified enhanced PLA; 'x' is nobufil's trade designation for its toughened grades, mapped to pla-plus on chemistry.

product_lines.name: PETG (incl. matte)
product_lines.notes: Standard PETG plus a matte-additive variant; pla-matte is PLA-based so only the base id applies.

product_lines.name: PCTG
product_lines.notes: Glycol-modified copolyester, tougher and clearer than PETG.

product_lines.name: PCx
product_lines.notes: Enhanced polycarbonate grade; no blend composition published, so the base pc id applies.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 28-60/kg. The recycled-feedstock positioning is central to the brand: material is sourced from European industrial plastic waste streams rather than virgin resin, and extrusion is done in-house in Krems.
